sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Adammair is an Irish god. He appears in myth as the husband of the woodland goddess Flidais. He remains obscure when set beside his consort. Few myths are tied to him alone. The source gives no further detail at this heading.
objective: This article establishes Ádammair as the obscure Irish god husband of the woodland goddess Flidais.
key_results: He is the husband of the woodland goddess Flidais.
He is obscure in comparison to his consort.
He is called a fairy in some accounts.
